text:
Priya Desai: hi everyone! Priya here, joined product this morning. Quick q: I don’t yet see the Sandbox API key in 1Password and my laptop is still in transit. Can someone point me to the minimal setup so I can run the playground endpoints from home? Also: fun fact — I climbed Kilimanjaro last year and carry a peak rock in my desk plant. :)

Andre Lopez: welcome @Priya Desai!! I’m your onboarding buddy. For quick testing without a local laptop you can use the hosted sandbox: https://sandbox.redwood.ai/playground. 1) request temporary sandbox-key in 1Password temp (see onboarding doc) or 2) use the guest API key below for low-rate testing until IT issues your real creds. I’ll DM you for calendar sync.

Devex Bot: Heads-up: guest sandbox keys are rate-limited (10 req/min). To fetch a guest key via curl:

```
curl -X POST https://sandbox.redwood.ai/v1/guest_key -d '{"email":"priya.desai@redwood.ai"}'
# returns {"guest_key":"guest_XXXX"}
```

Camille Park: welcome Priya!! People Ops note: lunch on Friday for all new hires meet-n-greet in the kitchen at 12:30. Also tag @Sabrina Liu if you need help with payroll or benefits.

Sabrina Liu: hey @Priya Desai welcome! I’ve sent the 1Password invite for product/team entries; you should have an email. If it doesn’t show up check spam and then let me know.

Priya Desai: saw the invite land, thanks Sabrina. tried the guest key flow and the playground works! super excited. Andre, open to sync at 3pm today. Also re: Kilimanjaro I have photos if anyone wants to see them.

IT Support Bot: Asset tag ASSET-7721 assigned to Priya Desai. Shipping delay noted eta 2 business days. If you need a loaner laptop before then, reply "loaner please" and confirm your time zone.

Andre Lopez: 3pm works. Also we have a tradition of "two truths and a weird skill" in intros if you want to prep one. Kilimanjaro photo request accepted.

Priya Desai: loaner please (PST). Thanks all really appreciate the warm welcome!
